title: 兴趣管理与 AOI 裁剪
html:
兴趣管理与 AOI 裁剪

核心概念

兴趣管理（Interest Management） 解决这样一个问题：在有 1000 个玩家的大型 MMO 中，服务器显然不能向每个客户端发送所有其他 999 个玩家的状态更新——这将消耗 999× 的带宽，而玩家只能看到附近的几十个人。AOI（Area of Interest，兴趣区域） 系统根据空间距离、视角、重要性等维度，精确控制每个客户端应接收哪些实体的更新。

实现方案 查询复杂度 更新代价 内存占用 适用场景
全量扫描 O(N²) O(1) O(N) <50 实体
静态格子分区 O(k) O(1) O(N+G) 均匀分布
动态 KD 树 O(log N) O(log N) O(N) 非均匀分布
四叉树/八叉树 O(log N) O(log N) O(N) 2D/3D 动态场景

静态格子分区（Grid-based AOI）

最简单也最常用的 AOI 方案，将世界划分为固定大小的格子，玩家查询相邻格子：

class GridAOI {
  private cells: Map<string, Set<EntityId>>;
  private entityPositions: Map<EntityId, { cell: string; pos: Vec2 }>;
  private readonly CELL_SIZE: number;

  constructor(cellSize = 100) {
    this.cells = new Map();
    this.entityPositions = new Map();
    this.CELL_SIZE = cellSize;
  }

  private getCellKey(x: number, y: number): string {
    const cx = Math.floor(x / this.CELL_SIZE);
    const cy = Math.floor(y / this.CELL_SIZE);
    return `${cx},${cy}`;
  }

  // 注册或更新实体位置
  update(id: EntityId, pos: Vec2): void {
    const newCell = this.getCellKey(pos.x, pos.y);
    const old = this.entityPositions.get(id);

    if (old?.cell === newCell) return; // 未跨格子，无需更新

    // 从旧格子移除
    if (old) this.cells.get(old.cell)?.delete(id);

    // 加入新格子
    if (!this.cells.has(newCell)) this.cells.set(newCell, new Set());
    this.cells.get(newCell)!.add(id);
    this.entityPositions.set(id, { cell: newCell, pos });
  }

  // 查询 viewerPos 附近 radius 内的所有实体
  query(viewerPos: Vec2, radius: number): EntityId[] {
    const cellRadius = Math.ceil(radius / this.CELL_SIZE);
    const cx = Math.floor(viewerPos.x / this.CELL_SIZE);
    const cy = Math.floor(viewerPos.y / this.CELL_SIZE);
    const result: EntityId[] = [];

    for (let dx = -cellRadius; dx <= cellRadius; dx++) {
      for (let dy = -cellRadius; dy <= cellRadius; dy++) {
        const key = `${cx + dx},${cy + dy}`;
        const cell = this.cells.get(key);
        if (!cell) continue;

        for (const id of cell) {
          const { pos } = this.entityPositions.get(id)!;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(pos.x - viewerPos.x, 2) + Math.pow(pos.y - viewerPos.y, 2));
          if (dist <= radius) result.push(id);
        }
      }
    }

    return result;
  }
}

动态 KD 树

当实体分布极度不均（如城市区域密集、野外稀疏），静态格子会产生某些格子查询量极大的热点问题。KD 树自适应地按实体密度划分空间：

class KDTreeNode {
  point: Vec2;
  id: EntityId;
  left: KDTreeNode | null = null;
  right: KDTreeNode | null = null;
  axis: 0 | 1; // 0 = X 轴划分，1 = Y 轴划分

  constructor(point: Vec2, id: EntityId, axis: 0 | 1) {
    this.point = point;
    this.id = id;
    this.axis = axis;
  }
}

class KDTree {
  private root: KDTreeNode | null = null;

  build(points: Array<{ pos: Vec2; id: EntityId }>, depth = 0): KDTreeNode | null {
    if (points.length === 0) return null;

    const axis = (depth % 2) as 0 | 1;
    const sorted = [...points].sort((a, b) => a.pos[axis === 0 ? 'x' : 'y'] - b.pos[axis === 0 ? 'x' : 'y']);
    const medianIdx = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
    const median = sorted[medianIdx];

    const node = new KDTreeNode(median.pos, median.id, axis);
    node.left = this.build(sorted.slice(0, medianIdx), depth + 1);
    node.right = this.build(sorted.slice(medianIdx + 1), depth + 1);
    return node;
  }

  // K 最近邻查询
  queryRadius(center: Vec2, radius: number): EntityId[] {
    const result: EntityId[] = [];
    this.searchRadius(this.root, center, radius, result);
    return result;
  }

  private searchRadius(node: KDTreeNode | null, center: Vec2, radius: number, result: EntityId[]): void {
    if (!node) return;

    const dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(node.point.x - center.x, 2) + Math.pow(node.point.y - center.y, 2));
    if (dist <= radius) result.push(node.id);

    // KD 树剪枝：只递归距离分割面 < radius 的子树
    const axisKey = node.axis === 0 ? 'x' : 'y';
    const axisDist = Math.abs(node.point[axisKey] - center[axisKey]);

    if (center[axisKey] < node.point[axisKey]) {
      this.searchRadius(node.left, center, radius, result);
      if (axisDist <= radius) this.searchRadius(node.right, center, radius, result);
    } else {
      this.searchRadius(node.right, center, radius, result);
      if (axisDist <= radius) this.searchRadius(node.left, center, radius, result);
    }
  }
}

优先级队列与带宽分配

AOI 确定了哪些实体可以被发送；优先级队列决定在带宽有限时实际发送哪些实体：

class PriorityReplicationSystem {
  private updateQueue: PriorityQueue<EntityUpdate>;
  private readonly BYTES_PER_TICK = 1200; // 约 1 个 MTU
  private lastSentTime: Map<EntityId, number> = new Map();

  computePriority(entity: EntityState, viewer: ViewerContext): number {
    const dist = distance(entity.position, viewer.position);

    // 距离因子：近的优先级高
    const distanceFactor = 1000 / (dist + 1);

    // 运动因子：移动中的实体优先
    const motionFactor = entity.velocity.magnitude > 0.1 ? 2.0 : 0.5;

    // 重要性因子：玩家 > NPC > 环境
    const importanceFactor = entity.type === 'PLAYER' ? 3.0 : entity.type === 'NPC' ? 1.5 : 1.0;

    // 饥饿保护：长时间未发送的实体获得优先级加成
    const lastSent = this.lastSentTime.get(entity.id) ?? 0;
    const staleness = (Date.now() - lastSent) / 1000; // 秒
    const stalenessFactor = 1 + staleness * 0.5;

    return distanceFactor * motionFactor * importanceFactor * stalenessFactor;
  }

  buildPacket(viewer: ViewerContext, candidates: EntityState[]): NetworkPacket {
    const updates: EntityUpdate[] = [];
    let remainingBudget = this.BYTES_PER_TICK;

    // 按优先级排序
    const sorted = candidates
      .map((e) => ({ entity: e, priority: this.computePriority(e, viewer) }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);

    for (const { entity } of sorted) {
      const encodedSize = this.estimateEncodedSize(entity);
      if (encodedSize > remainingBudget) continue;

      updates.push(this.encode(entity, viewer.id));
      remainingBudget -= encodedSize;
      this.lastSentTime.set(entity.id, Date.now());
    }

    return { updates, tick: this.currentTick };
  }
}

AOI 事件：进入/离开区域通知

除了状态更新，AOI 系统还需要处理实体进入/离开观察者视野的事件：

class AOIEventSystem {
  private observerSubscriptions: Map<ClientId, Set<EntityId>> = new Map();

  // 每 tick 检查订阅变化
  updateSubscriptions(client: ClientId, newVisible: EntityId[]): void {
    const oldVisible = this.observerSubscriptions.get(client) ?? new Set();
    const newSet = new Set(newVisible);

    // 新进入视野的实体：发送完整快照
    const entered = newVisible.filter((id) => !oldVisible.has(id));
    if (entered.length > 0) {
      this.sendFullSnapshots(client, entered);
    }

    // 离开视野的实体：通知客户端删除
    const exited = [...oldVisible].filter((id) => !newSet.has(id));
    if (exited.length > 0) {
      this.sendDespawnNotifications(client, exited);
    }

    this.observerSubscriptions.set(client, newSet);
  }

  private sendFullSnapshots(client: ClientId, entityIds: EntityId[]): void {
    // 新进入的实体必须发全量快照（客户端没有基线）
    for (const id of entityIds) {
      const entity = this.getEntityState(id);
      network.send(client, { type: 'SPAWN', entityId: id, state: entity });
    }
  }
}

小结

  • 静态格子 AOI 实现简单，查询 O(k)（k 为格子中实体数），适合实体均匀分布的场景
  • KD 树 自适应空间分布，更新代价 O(log N)，适合实体密度差异大的开放世界
  • 优先级队列在带宽不足时确保最重要的更新优先发出，饥饿保护防止低优先级实体长时间不同步
  • 进入/离开事件 是 AOI 系统的关键交互：进入时必须发送全量快照（建立基线），离开时通知客户端清理
  • AOI 与增量压缩是互补的：AOI 控制"发给谁"，增量压缩控制"发什么"，两者组合才能实现大规模游戏的高效同步
